3/Stock split - I’m not predicting that $TSLA will split its stock this year, but if mgmt were thinking about it, the authorized shares need to increase from 2B, and the time to do that is when the 2022 proxy goes out (deadline 5/2). Expect such an increase in authorized shares.

2/ $TSLA P/E - While improving, TSLA WS P/E of 73x 2023 EPS is still down from its 140x Nov peak. Once investors start forecasting 2023 EPS of ~$20/sh (WS $13.90), TSLA stock will outrun its P/E and a more normal P/E of 2x PEG on 2023 EPS and future growth of 40% will be applied.

5/ FSD - institutions put little incremental value on FSD other than as an add-on based on a take rate x $12K. Few model a $TSLA ride-hailing network because they believe every EV mnfr will have similar FSD capabilities approved at the same time. View it like a free option.

4/ Automotive share vs EV share - Bulls get annoyed by institutions’ convention of using SAAR x EV adoption x TSLA EV share to determine TSLA volumes. It’s just convention, and viewed as a higher degree of modeling accuracy to decompose $TSLA volumes into its component parts.

6/ $TSLA still seems super cheap on my 2022 EPS of $12.80 (79x) and 2023 EPS of $20 (51x), with 50% Vol/EPS growth driven by accelerating EV adoption. As long as TSLA opens 1-2 gigafactories every 2 years through 2030, it can achieve its 50% growth goal. $1,600 PT 6-12 mos.
